reward: W38 legal route event reward, absorbed at the first original 500 Hz task completion; zero bootstrap on success or original physical failure, bootstrap on time limit.

input: current measured Fz in leg order / (mass * g / 4)

standalone_fit.source: W57 pilot02 full and blind. Full episode raw ledgers including tails as target context only; perform supervision only on originally on-policy rows in naturally closed episodes with a known terminal.
standalone_fit.split: case and original episode ordinal shared across full and blind; every fifth serial is validation; all others training; virgin episodes.
standalone_fit.target: actual duration-discounted returns until original task completion. Bound missing split of nonpositive contact costs within final action, report interval width. Outputs and errors in original reward units.
standalone_fit.selection: fixed final epoch, no W59 holdout

actor.distribution: Gaussian pre-tanh latent, fixed exploration scale, log probability of the same sampled latent for PPO
actor.kl_rule: Check exact mean KL of fixed-std old versus new Gaussian on the full sealed batch after every proposed step, revert parameters and Adam state and stop actor steps on violation.

imagination.wm_differentiation: fixed ensembling parameters, preserve gradients to held input and state. Issue at true initial request. Learned future request flag selects detached P3 base and triggers a fresh actor action; hard mode changes have no local derivative.

admission: validated action gradient direction with replay floor and no extra real hard failures in sealed states; separately validate first actor proposal with eight locked states before/after per head. Failed check restores optimizer and actor. A fallback needs a distinct explicit identity.
